# Chart
A card that frames a chart: title, description, optional stat toggles, a plot area, an optional legend, and loading and empty states. The plot is a bar chart in v1.

USE WHEN
• Showing one metric over time or across categories (visitors per day, revenue per month)
• A dashboard tile that needs a title, a description and a quick way to switch the series
• A plot that can be empty or still loading

DON'T USE WHEN
• Showing a single number: use the stat cell alone or a Card
• The data is tabular: use a table
• Comparing several series with a shared legend: v1 draws one series only

DO
• Give every chart a title and a text description of what it shows
• Use the Stats switch for series toggles; the selected stat has the muted fill
• Show the loading or empty state instead of an empty plot
• Keep to one series in the primary colour

DON'T
• Rely on colour alone to tell series apart
• Put more than one chart in one Chart card
• Add gridlines or labels beyond the axis labels drawn here

PROPERTIES
• State: default | loading | empty
• Title, Description: text
• Stats: boolean, shows the Chart Stat cells in the header
• Legend: boolean, shows a legend row under the plot (default state)
Chart Stat (Selected false | true, Label, Value), Chart Tooltip (Label, Value) and Chart Legend Item (Label) are separate components. Bars use primary, gridlines border-subtle, axis text foreground-muted.
